# Matches of leak-patterns.txt that are not leaks. Perl-compatible regular expressions, one per
# line; an entry must match the whole matched text. Keep entries narrow: prefer changing the
# source (an RFC 5737 address, a neutral name) to adding one here.

# Unspecified, loopback, private (RFC 1918) and documentation (RFC 5737) IPv4 addresses.
0\.0\.0\.0
127\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+
10\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+
172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.\d+\.\d+
192\.168\.\d+\.\d+
192\.0\.2\.\d+
198\.51\.100\.\d+
203\.0\.113\.\d+
